title: sanitize_overview_field always allocates even when no sanitization needed
description: overview.rs sanitize_overview_field() always allocates a new String via chars().map().collect() even when no tab/CR/LF is present. For clean headers (the common case) this is 5 avoidable allocations per article. A fast path checking s.contains([...]) before allocating would handle the common case at zero cost.
